better_cobblemon_music.config.title: Better Cobblemon Music
better_cobblemon_music.config.scan_inter: How often the current field and battle context is checked. Lower values react faster but cost more CPU.
better_cobblemon_music.config.field_chan: How long a new field context must remain stable before its playlist starts.
better_cobblemon_music.config.between_tr: Default silence between tracks unless a playlist overrides it.
better_cobblemon_music.config.fade_in.to: How long new music takes to reach its configured volume.
better_cobblemon_music.config.fade_out.t: How long outgoing music takes to stop.
Used by playlists that do not specify their own selection mode.
better_cobblemon_music.config.volume.too: Used by playlists that do not specify their own volume. 1.0 is normal volume.
better_cobblemon_music.config.hit_sounds: Plays an effectiveness-based hit sound when a move reduces HP.
better_cobblemon_music.config.hit_sound_: Hit sound volume. 1.0 is normal, 0.0 is silent, and 2.0 is the maximum.
better_cobblemon_music.config.last_pokem: Muffles music below half HP and adds a heartbeat at red HP for your last Pokémon.
Heartbeat volume. Muffle strength stays fixed. 1.0 is normal; 0.0 silences only the heartbeat.
better_cobblemon_music.config.advanced.d: Biome, dimension, battle, trainer, and Pokémon music mappings remain in music.json. After saving this screen, run /bcm reload in a world to apply every change.
better_cobblemon_music.config.cloth_miss: Cloth Config is not installed. Install it to edit global playback settings here, or edit music.json directly.
better_cobblemon_music.config.save.succe: Settings saved. Run /bcm reload in a world to apply them.
